description: ASR ProtectionContainer provider-specific details are polymorphic on instanceType (A2A, Azure, HyperVReplicaAzure, InMageRcm, ...); the converted model keeps only the `instanceType` discriminator, so S.Struct strips every subtype field on encode and decode. Retype them as untyped documents.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Provider specific inputs for container creation. Polymorphic on `instanceType` (list of provider-specific objects, e.g. `[{ instanceType: "A2A", ... }]`).
Fabric specific details. Polymorphic on `instanceType` (e.g. `{ instanceType: "A2A", ... }`).
